metrics.name: facebookAds.impressions
metrics.label: Impressions
metrics.description: The number of times your ads were on screen, including when the same person saw your ad more than once.

metrics.name: facebookAds.clicks
metrics.label: Link clicks
metrics.description: Clicks on links in your ads that go to destinations such as your website, app, or a Meta experience.

metrics.name: facebookAds.spend
metrics.label: Amount spent
metrics.description: Total amount spent on your ads during the reporting period, in your account currency.

metrics.name: facebookAds.reach
metrics.label: Reach
metrics.description: The number of people who saw your ads at least once. Reach is an estimated metric.

metrics.name: facebookAds.frequency
metrics.label: Frequency
metrics.description: The average number of times each person saw your ad (impressions divided by reach).

metrics.name: facebookAds.uniqueClicks
metrics.label: Unique link clicks
metrics.description: The number of people who performed at least one link click. Differs from link clicks when the same person clicks multiple times.

metrics.name: facebookAds.ctr
metrics.label: CTR (all)
metrics.description: The percentage of impressions that received any click type (all clicks divided by impressions).

metrics.name: facebookAds.uniqueCtr
metrics.label: Unique CTR
metrics.description: The percentage of people who saw your ad and clicked a link (unique link clicks divided by reach).

metrics.name: facebookAds.cpc
metrics.label: CPC (all)
metrics.description: The average cost for each click of any type (amount spent divided by all clicks).

metrics.name: facebookAds.cpm
metrics.label: CPM
metrics.description: The average cost per 1,000 impressions (amount spent divided by impressions, ×1,000).

metrics.name: facebookAds.cpp
metrics.label: Cost per purchase
metrics.description: The average cost for each purchase attributed to your ads.

metrics.name: facebookAds.actions
metrics.label: Actions
metrics.description: Counts of specific action types on your ads (for example purchases, leads, or other standard events), often used with action breakdowns.

metrics.name: facebookAds.actionValues
metrics.label: Action value
metrics.description: The total monetary value reported for actions on your ads, in your account currency.

metrics.name: facebookAds.costPerActionType
metrics.label: Cost per action type
metrics.description: Average cost for each action of a given type when broken down by action type.

metrics.name: facebookAds.websiteCtr
metrics.label: Website CTR
metrics.description: The percentage of impressions that resulted in a link click to your website.

metrics.name: facebookAds.reachPerSpend
metrics.label: Reach per spend
metrics.description: People reached per unit of currency spent (reach / spend). Distinct from cpp and other native cost metrics.

metrics.name: facebookAds.uniqueClickSharePercent
metrics.label: Unique click share %
metrics.description: Percentage of total clicks that came from unique users: unique clicks ÷ total clicks.

dimensions.name: facebookAds.date
dimensions.label: Date
dimensions.description: Date when the ad metrics were recorded.

dimensions.name: facebookAds.dateStop
dimensions.label: End date
dimensions.description: End date for the reporting period.

dimensions.name: facebookAds.campaignName
dimensions.label: Campaign
dimensions.description: Name of the ad campaign. Shown in campaign reports and breakdowns.

dimensions.name: facebookAds.campaignId
dimensions.label: Campaign ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the ad campaign in Facebook Ads Manager.

dimensions.name: facebookAds.adGroupId
dimensions.label: Ad group ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the ad group (adset) in Facebook Ads Manager.

dimensions.name: facebookAds.adName
dimensions.label: Ad
dimensions.description: Name of the ad. Shown in ad-level reports and breakdowns.

dimensions.name: facebookAds.adId
dimensions.label: Ad ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the ad in Facebook Ads Manager.

dimensions.name: facebookAds.publisherPlatform
dimensions.label: Platform
dimensions.description: Meta platform where the ad was shown (Facebook, Instagram, Audience Network, etc.).

dimensions.name: facebookAds.devicePlatform
dimensions.label: Device platform
dimensions.description: Device class where the ad was shown (mobile, desktop, etc.).

dimensions.name: facebookAds.country
dimensions.label: Country
dimensions.description: Country where people who saw your ads were located.

dimensions.name: facebookAds.age
dimensions.label: Age
dimensions.description: Age range of people who saw your ads (used with age breakdowns).

dimensions.name: facebookAds.gender
dimensions.label: Gender
dimensions.description: Gender of people who saw your ads (used with gender breakdowns).

dimensions.name: facebookAds.platformPosition
dimensions.label: Platform position
dimensions.description: Position where the ad was shown within the platform (e.g. feed, stories, right column).

dimensions.name: facebookAds.impressionDevice
dimensions.label: Impression device
dimensions.description: Device on which the ad impression was recorded (e.g. mobile, desktop).

dimensions.name: facebookAds.region
dimensions.label: Region
dimensions.description: Region or state where people who saw your ads were located.

dimensions.name: facebookAds.dma
dimensions.label: DMA region
dimensions.description: Designated market area (US TV markets) for geographic breakdowns. Deprecated by Facebook; requests are routed to comscore_market.

dimensions.name: facebookAds.comscoreMarket
dimensions.label: Comscore market
dimensions.description: Comscore market for US geographic breakdowns (replaces deprecated dma).

dimensions.name: facebookAds.hourlyStatsAggregatedByAdvertiserTimeZone
dimensions.label: Hour of day (advertiser time zone)
dimensions.description: Hour of the day the ad was served, aggregated in the advertiser's time zone.
